description: Best Practice Analyzer rules for Power BI semantic-model AI-readiness.

rules.why: Copilot reads measure descriptions to disambiguate metrics.

rules.test: IsHidden = false and (Description is null or empty)
rules.why: Descriptions give AI the meaning names cannot.
Table descriptions clarify grain and purpose.
AI reads names literally; cryptic names like fct_sls mean nothing.

rules.test: Name ends with Id/Key/Ky and IsHidden = false
rules.why: Surrogate keys pollute the fields AI can choose from.
Keys and Year should never be summed by default.
Formatting makes AI answers readable ($, %, thousands).
Synonyms let users ask in their own words (Revenue = Sales).
Stops Copilot from silently auto-aggregating raw columns instead of your measures.
Controls Excel pivot / MDX behavior; set intentionally for AI + Excel consumers.
Auto date tables clutter the model; use one proper marked date dimension.

rules.test: Name is a month/day name and SortByColumn is empty
rules.why: Without SortByColumn, AI output orders months/days alphabetically.

rules.test: Expression uses bare / instead of DIVIDE()
rules.why: DIVIDE() handles divide-by-zero gracefully for clean AI answers.

rules.test: Expression uses FILTER() where KEEPFILTERS() would be safe
rules.why: KEEPFILTERS() is cleaner and faster than FILTER() over a full table.
